cards.name: Strike
cards.description: Deal 6 damage.
cards.lore: Even a lesser angel must sometimes answer force with force. A measured blow opens the way forward without turning the mission into slaughter.

cards.name: Warding Sweep
cards.description: The old guard's circle still holds. Deal 4 damage to all enemies.
cards.lore: A wide arc once taught to those who kept the threshold. It was meant to drive the fallen back from the sanctum, not to cut them down.

cards.name: Defend
cards.description: Gain 5 block.
cards.lore: Before learning greater rites, the angel learns simply to endure. Protection leaves room for mercy when strength alone would end the fight.

cards.name: Poison Dagger
cards.description: Deal 4 damage. Apply 3 Poison for 3 turns.
cards.lore: A small blade carries only a measured trace of poison. The angel uses it to weaken resistance, never forgetting that the fallen are meant to be released.

cards.name: Expose
cards.description: Apply 2 Vulnerable to all enemies for 2 turns.
cards.lore: Corruption leaves fractures even when the fallen cannot see them. The angel learns to recognise those weaknesses and bring them into the light.

cards.name: Inner Focus
cards.description: Gain 2 Strength for the rest of combat.
cards.lore: The angel gathers strength by holding purpose steady against the corruption ahead. Resolve becomes a power that lasts as long as the struggle does.

cards.name: Bandage
cards.description: Heal 6 health.
cards.lore: Not every wound requires divine intervention. A simple binding is often enough to keep the angel moving toward the work still unfinished.

cards.name: Sentinel's Rebuke
cards.description: A final admonition recalls the fallen to silence. Deal 4 damage. Apply 1 Feeble for 2 turns.
cards.lore: The sentinel strikes without hatred. Something buried in the fallen still remembers that voice, and its hand falters.

cards.name: Poison Flask
cards.description: A measured dose draws corruption to the surface. Apply 5 Poison for 3 turns.
cards.lore: The flask was prepared for those whose corruption could not be seen. Its contents bring the hidden sickness into the open.

cards.name: Poison Blade
cards.description: The blade reaches beneath the fallen's defences. Deal 10 piercing damage, ignoring Block and Armour. Apply 4 Poison for 2 turns.
cards.lore: This blade was kept for the fallen who hid behind corrupted armour. It finds the gap, and through it, the one still trapped inside.

cards.name: Poison Cloud
cards.description: A bitter mist exposes the stain within. Apply 3 Poison to all enemies for 3 turns.
cards.lore: The vapour was made for corruption that spreads through a gathering. It draws the taint into the open, and those caught within are not yet lost.

cards.name: Poison Mark
cards.description: A quiet sign reveals where the corruption has taken hold. Apply 2 Vulnerable and 2 Poison to an enemy for 2 turns.
cards.lore: Some corruption hides too deep to be seen at a glance. Where the mark glows, help is still owed.

cards.name: Starfall
cards.description: Heaven's light falls upon those still bound. Deal 6 damage to all enemies.
cards.lore: Falling stars carry a grave light into places burdened by corruption. Where they land, the fallen are given a chance at release.

cards.name: Rift Lance
cards.description: A shaft of starlight loosens corruption's hold. Deal 4 damage. Apply 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns.
cards.lore: A narrow shaft of starlight opens a breach in corruption's hold. Through that wound, the fallen may yet be reached.

cards.name: Warden's Judgement
cards.description: Mercy is pronounced beneath a broken oath. Deal 9 damage.
cards.lore: The warden's blow falls once, heavy and certain, so that what was corrupted may finally be still. It is the last kindness a guardian can offer.

cards.name: Break the Seal
cards.description: No ward shall bar the way to absolution. Reduce the enemy's armour by 3, then deal 2 damage.
cards.lore: Corruption seals itself around what it has taken, hard as stone. This rite breaks that seal first, so that release can reach what lies beneath.

cards.name: Astral Ward
cards.description: The old star-readers' ward steadies the weary. Gain 4 Block and 1 Strength for the rest of combat. Restore 1 Energy.
cards.lore: Beneath a quiet veil of starlight, the weary gather the strength to endure. Each steady breath holds the line a little longer.

cards.name: Restoring Light
cards.description: A quiet celestial rite sustains the wounded. Heal 6 HP at the start of your next 3 turns.
cards.lore: A faint light lingers where hope has nearly departed. With patience and solemn care, the wounded are guided back toward life.

cards.name: Humble Sanctuary
cards.description: Even a lesser blessing can become a refuge. Gain 7 Block. Heal 3.
cards.lore: Where corruption has left little untouched, the angel makes a small refuge from what grace remains. It offers only enough safety to continue the work ahead.

cards.name: Consecrated Rampart
cards.description: Even broken stone can bear a sacred ward. Gain 12 Block.
cards.lore: Broken stone can still be given purpose. The angel raises a simple ward to endure the fallen without answering their corruption with destruction.

cards.name: Balm of Grace
cards.description: Grace settles into wounded flesh. Heal 10 health.
cards.lore: Not every wound calls for a miracle. A small measure of grace is enough to restore the angel and keep the journey moving.

cards.name: Purify
cards.description: The stain of corruption is washed away. Remove all negative effects from yourself.
cards.lore: Corruption can cling even to those sent to cleanse it. The angel turns that same discipline inward before continuing the work of release.

cards.name: Sealed Pact
cards.description: An oath no angel should bind. Gain 3 Strength and 6 Block.
cards.lore: When safer means fail, the angel binds a dangerous power close at hand. The pact is a burden, carried only as long as the task requires.

upgrade.name: Sealed Pact+
upgrade.description: An oath no angel should bind. Gain 4 Strength and 9 Block.

cards.name: Blood Price
cards.description: The cost of release is paid in your own strength. Deal 20 damage.
cards.lore: Forbidden strength is spent in one costly blow. It is used to break corruption's hold, not to rule by fear.

upgrade.name: Blood Price+
upgrade.description: The cost of release is paid in your own strength. Deal 28 damage.

cards.name: Doom Sigil
cards.description: A mark that lays corruption bare. Apply 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns and 4 Poison for 3 turns.
cards.lore: A forbidden sign names the place where ruin has settled. It holds that taint in place, so it can spread no further unseen.

upgrade.name: Doom Sigil+
upgrade.description: A mark that lays corruption bare. Apply 2 Vulnerable for 2 turns and 6 Poison for 3 turns.

cards.name: Iron Oath
cards.description: You swear upon iron that the fallen shall be released. Gain 4 Armour.
cards.lore: An oath of iron is sworn when ordinary wards will not hold. The bond does not loosen, and neither does the angel's guard.

upgrade.name: Iron Oath+
upgrade.description: You swear upon iron that the fallen shall be released. Gain 6 Armour.
